seo_title: BeMe Case Study: Supplement Ad Similarity | SOMIN
description: SOMIN compared 3,222 posts and ads from BeMe and five supplement rivals and found that 1,858 of 2,174 ads told one beauty, wellness and self-care story.
eyebrow: Brand case study · Beauty and wellness supplements · Paid and organic social
h1: BeMe and five rivals ran 2,174 ads, and 1,858 told the same story
lede: SOMIN analysed 3,222 posts and ads from BeMe and five supplement rivals. Most ads told one beauty, wellness and self-care story, and rivals' content was 85.73% to 91.12% similar to BeMe's.
meta_line: A SOMIN brand briefing · 4 years organic, 6 months paid · Six supplement brands

stats.label: In one beauty, wellness and self-care theme

challenge.title: How similar BeMe's content is to five supplement rivals
challenge.body: Rivals: Absolute Collagen, MaryRuth's, NeoCell, Vital Proteins and Youtheory. Which audiences and problems do their ads address, and where is a distinct angle?

approach.title: 3,222 posts and ads labelled, compared and clustered
points: Tagged all content with SOMIN's content concept framework.
Clustered 2,174 ads by basic insight, then by addressable problem.
Explored society, psychology and economic angles on skincare and haircare doubts.

findings_title: 1,858 ads in one theme, and rivals close to BeMe

findings.title: 1,858 of 2,174 ads tell one beauty and self-care story
findings.body: Split by basic insight, against 302 for Wellness, Care, and Relationships.

findings.title: Rivals are 85.73% to 91.12% similar to BeMe
findings.body: Vital Proteins is the least similar, NeoCell the most.

findings.title: MaryRuth's ran 47.65% of the ads, BeMe 8.56%
findings.body: That is 1,036 ads. Absolute Collagen ran 522 (24.01%) and BeMe 186.

delivered.title: Seven ad themes, a similarity matrix and three stories
points: A similarity matrix, plus the top diverging interests of MaryRuth's and Vital Proteins
Seven ad themes by basic insight, six by addressable problem, sized per brand
Doubt drivers, from body image and fear of ageing to the cost of quality products
Three stories: The Mirror of Doubt, The Reflection of Diversity and The Price of Perfection

quote.text: True beauty and confidence bloom from self-acceptance, not from chasing unattainable ideals.

outcome.title: BeMe can speak to buyers' doubts about skincare and haircare
outcome.body: The category tells one story in very similar ways. SOMIN's three expressions turn buyers' skincare and haircare doubts into stories of self-acceptance, diversity and value.

faq.a: 2,174 paid ads over six months and 1,048 organic posts over four years, from six brands.

faq.q: How did SOMIN measure brand similarity?
faq.a: Cosine similarity across audiences, interests, aspirations and needs, with BeMe as the 100% baseline; labels came from an Azure LLM and SODA.

faq.q: How are the story expressions made?
faq.a: A concept, its theme and a psychological factor form a story template that an LLM expands, ending in a one-line insight.
